briefs.brief: Desk view: WATCH (late). Live ladder MSFT > GOOG > AMZN > NBIS (09-15; GOOG and AMZN swapped vs 09-14; IREN dropped since 09-08). Why: Azure +43% (guide ~45%), Google Cloud +82% with a $514B backlog, AWS +37%; only MSFT is FCF-positive and GOOG just posted its first negative-FCF quarter (fc1fe16c05e3, cce2d746d529, secondary).
